name: CORE API
tagline: Search and retrieve open-access research papers and full text worldwide
description: CORE aggregates open-access research from repositories and journals worldwide and exposes it via REST APIs for discovery, full-text search, metadata retrieval, and bulk access. Developers use it to find papers by query, fetch works by identifier, and build scholarly search and analytics tools on open research content.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY header; obtain key after free registration on CORE

pricing.free_tier_limits: 1 batch request or 5 single requests per 10 seconds; free access is available without registration, subject to CORE's terms.

rate_limits: Free access: 1 batch request or 5 single requests per 10 seconds. Registered users receive better performance; faster/VIP rates are available by contacting CORE.
use_cases: search open-access papers by topic or keywords
fetch metadata and abstract for a paper by CORE id or DOI
retrieve full-text download links for open research works
find related scholarly works for a research query
bulk-discover papers from a repository or journal
